description: One of Baude's things as a scene is given it, to place and to draw by: a chat, a host, a Meta card, a window. Every app gives a scene the same ones, from what its hosts say.

id.description: Its id: a chat's host/session, a host's id, a card's, a window's.

name.description: What it's called, as every app shows it (a Bot's name; a chat's title).

host.description: Its host's id (a chat's, a card's, a window's).

state.description: Where it stands: a chat's working, waiting, idle or stopped (schema/types/Session.json); a host's up or down; a card's done, running or asking.

bot.description: Whether a chat is a Bot.

used.description: When it was last used, Unix seconds (a chat's last message).

unread.description: Whether a chat has a reply not looked at.
